properties.method: GFN2-xTB (xtb 6.5.0), gas phase, charge 0, multiplicity 1, T = 0 K electronic energies
properties.f_o_bde_note: BDE = E([O]OF) + E(F) - E(FOOF) = -12.612623903996 + -4.619339964238 - (-17.320490940495) = 0.08852706 Eh = 55.55 kcal/mol (electronic); 53.96 kcal/mol after ZPE (0 K). Experimental values for this weak bond are lower (~20-30 kcal/mol), so the absolute number is limited by the semiempirical level of theory; the geometric parameters, which are the primary target of the task, are reproduced well.

properties.description: Products of a single F-O bond fission: fluorooxy radical (doublet) + ground-state F atom (doublet). Components computed separately at GFN2-xTB, gas phase.

edges.channel: homolytic F-O bond fission, barrierless (no first-order saddle; relaxed F-O distance scan is monotonic)

properties.barrier_note: Barrierless: rigid F(1)-O(2) scan at GFN2-xTB (single points, runs/scan/r1..r8/foof.out) rises monotonically from the minimum (0.0) through 3.83, 13.26, 28.74, 42.22, 47.37, 48.95 to 49.25 kcal/mol at 5.0 A with no maximum, so no first-order saddle exists on this coordinate; barrier_kcal_mol = 0.0 is the level-of-theory statement that the step has no saddle, not a fitted number.
properties.note: A single F-O bond is broken; the O-O bond is retained. Bond map uses FOOF atom order: F(1)-O(2)-O(3)-F(4).
